name: Blackrock Caverns: Corla's Nether Beams come from the netherdrake corpse, not from Corla (#13820)
contract: #13820: Corla, Herald of Twilight 39679 drains the essence of the netherdrake corpse hanging above her room and
channels it into the kneeling Twilight Zealots 50284. Each beam is cast by a Nether Beam NPC 5011005, and the
soak line runs from that NPC to its zealot. The script summoned the beam NPCs on Corla herself, so the beams came
from the boss. Her out-of-combat Drain Essence already targets the corpse's invisible stalker 39842 (guid
6450039) at (573.60, 910.01, 180.34); the beam NPCs now stand there. The player waits beside the zealots, where
the issue was reported, about 66 yd (2D) from the corpse point and about 14 yd from Corla. The nearest beam NPC must
be at the corpse distance; a beam on Corla would be about 14 yd away. After engaging Corla, the player stands
on the beam line just in front of the east zealot, close enough in 2D but outside the old 3D prefilter.
The player's Evolution stacks prove that they intercepted the beam.
